import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    # first integer is n, ignore
    n = int(data[0])  # not used
    a = [int(data[1]), int(data[2]), int(data[3])]
    b = [int(data[4]), int(data[5]), int(data[6])]
    
    max_val = 0
    min_val = 0
    for i in range(3):
        max_val += min(a[i], b[(i+1)%3])
        left = a[i] - b[i] - b[(i+2)%3]
        if left > 0:
            min_val += left
    print(f"{min_val} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
